i18n.name: Settlement Place Names
i18n.description: Settlement place names projected from the Lands Department Place Name database. The divisions projection retains PLACE_CLASS=Settlement records as point divisions; the source also contains Hydrographic and Topographic records, which are not divisions.

i18n.name: 居住地名稱
i18n.description: 由地政總署地名資料庫投影的居住地名稱。區劃投影保留 PLACE_CLASS=Settlement 的點區劃；來源亦包含水文及地形記錄，這些不屬於區劃。

i18n.name: 居住地名称
i18n.description: 由地政总署地名数据库投影的居住地名称。区划投影保留 PLACE_CLASS=Settlement 的点区划；来源亦包含水文及地形记录，这些不属于区划。
